test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U. P is sitting third to the right of U. Q is sitting immediate left to S. S is sitting second to the right of P. What is the position of T with respect to P?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) P is sitting third to the right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8253c90cedbbaf592e9847745ced58de23f1531ac0d8af1004312f088f8e2d3.png] 

2) S is sitting second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79cb5d46cad46c64f24538e0e4d28b4ece13ce38cc6fbf273567e100de7f1b23.png] 

3) Q is sitting immediate left to S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c2186c471c99a5c9588c47166fe3b95fd3cebe0a910f8f7c7b9c825bdd2f0df.png] 

4) R is an immediate neighbour of both T and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98d05993dc8ae009ed8995e5228109273cec293cbc6f3e2dd6d90ef46cdcfc32.png] 

Here, we can see that T is sitting to the immediate left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Immediate left"**.
